children: The USDA says 100,000 metric tons of U.S. corn exports were sold to Mexico for delivery in the 2026/27 marketing year. It's the first sale to Mexico in nearly two weeks, with most of the activity reported this month coming by way of export sales to China. No new flash sale to China has been reported by the USDA so far this week. CBOT grain futures are lower, with most-active corn down 0.9%, soybeans off 0.5%, and wheat 0.3% lower. (kirk.maltais@wsj.com)
